name: Da Lat
provinceNote: Lam Dong now also includes the former Dak Nong and Binh Thuan provinces, so Mui Ne shares the province on paper.
dotReason: Worth a special trip in this corridor
summary: Sleep by Xuan Huong Lake when you want cool air, pine ridges, and a market slope of strawberries. Fly into Lien Khuong or bus up from Ho Chi Minh City. Go to Nha Trang or Mui Ne when the beach is the trip; they are still hours apart by road.
fee: The lake is free; palaces, gardens, and waterfalls ticket separately
getThere: Lien Khuong Airport (DLI), about 30 km south of town, with flights from Ha Noi and Ho Chi Minh City
seoTitle: Da Lat travel guide — lake, market, and cool highlands
seoDescription: Xuan Huong Lake, the market slope, and pine-country waterfalls. Lien Khuong is about 30 km south. December to March is the driest window.
intro: Wake to mist on Xuan Huong Lake and air cool enough for a jacket while the coast is hot. The shore walk and Lam Vien Square are the morning; the sloping market above the lake is strawberries, flowers, and avocado ice cream before lunch.

Stay if the highlands are the trip. Book Nha Trang or Mui Ne when you wanted sand. They share a province on paper after the merger and they are still a long ride apart, so link them from Ho Chi Minh City rather than in one afternoon.

Give a southbound half-day to the cable car from Robin Hill, Truc Lam monastery, and Tuyen Lam Lake, or to Datanla Falls on Prenn Pass. Lang Biang is the northbound half-day. Crazy House and Bao Dai Palace III fit between lake mornings. The tourist railway station is the art-deco run toward mosaic-covered Linh Phuoc at Trai Mat.

After dark the night market lanes grill rice paper and pour hot soy milk while the lake path stays lit. The 11th Flower Festival in 2026 opens at Lam Vien Square on 19 December and closes on 31 December, with displays into early January. Odd-year December is the pattern; confirm the next year on arrival.
gettingAround: Lien Khuong Airport is about 30 km south on National Highway 20. Vietnam Tourism names flights from Ha Noi and Ho Chi Minh City; the road minutes and taxi fare are check on arrival. In town, walk the lake and market, and use Grab or a taxi for Prenn Pass, Lang Biang, and Trai Mat. Easy-rider motorbike loops to waterfalls are common; ride yourself only with the proper license.

stayAreas.name: Pine ridges
stayAreas.summary: Quieter beds above the basin with valley views. No hotel street is published as a pick.

eat: Morning is the market slope: strawberries with condensed milk, artichoke tea souvenirs, and banh mi from a counter. Evening is the night market for banh trang nuong and soy milk. Coffee belongs to the hills around Cau Dat; the food guide names areas, not shops.
interestsBody: Dining is market strawberries, kem bo, and night-market rice paper. The food guide is photo-led.
Coffee is Arabica country on the Cau Dat hills and slow cups after the lake walk. Farm names on Vietnam Tourism are tours, not picks.
Lakes and waterfalls are Xuan Huong in town, then Tuyen Lam, Datanla, and Lang Biang on half-day rides.
French hill-station architecture is the railway station, Bao Dai Palace III, the Chicken Church, Domaine de Marie, and Crazy House.
Flowers are Lam Vien Square and the December festival displays around the lake in odd years. The ticketed city flower garden has no licensed card photo in this pass.
Cool evenings are the night market and the lakeside walk, not a beach-bar strip.

season.label: December to March
season.note: Vietnam Tourism names December to March as dry, cool, and sunny, with wild sunflowers on the hills in late autumn. Rain is concentrated May to October, and nights turn chilly November to January. Flower-festival displays in December 2026 are planned around Xuan Huong Lake; road closures those nights are check on arrival.

faqs.q: Can you combine Da Lat and Mui Ne?
faqs.a: They share a province after the merger and they are still a long ride apart. Fly or bus each one from Ho Chi Minh City rather than linking them in a day. Drive minutes are check on arrival.

faqs.q: How do you reach town from Lien Khuong Airport?
faqs.a: The airport is about 30 km south on Highway 20. Vietnam Tourism names flights from Ha Noi and Ho Chi Minh City. Taxi minutes and fares are check on arrival.
